project.name: fplogin
project.tagline: Biometric Fingerprint Authentication for Linux Display Managers
project.target_v1: Arch Linux · systemd · SDDM 0.21.0 · fprintd / libfprint · Hyprland
project.latest_achievement: S4, S5, S6A, S7A completed: Core transaction installer, analyzer, security hardening & release docs verified
project.next_step: G05 (Fingerprint 30s deadline, timeout cleanup & races under autonomous guest-event timing)

sprints.name: Foundation Gate
sprints.subtitle: Contracts, Schemas, Trust Boundaries & Conformance Baseline
sprints.goal: Establish DM-independent contracts, static descriptors, JSON schemas, and Go protocol boundaries before any DM-specific code.

items.title: Core–Adapter Architecture Analysis
items.description: Documented CORE_ADAPTER_ANALYSIS.md establishing Go core, out-of-process adapters, and DM-neutrality.

items.title: ADR 0001: Core Language Decision
items.description: Selected Go for authoritative core; restricted Bash to thin wrappers; avoided in-process shared library plugins.

items.title: ADR 0002: Adapter Process Protocol
items.description: Root-owned static descriptors and versioned JSON-over-stdin/stdout bounded subprocess envelope.

items.title: ADR 0003: Transaction Journaling
items.description: Pre-mutation durable journal, fsync ordering, atomic rollback compensation, and final manifest publication.

items.title: contracts/adapter/v1 Schemas
items.description: JSON schemas for descriptor, request, response, and change-plan with closed operation kinds.

items.title: contracts/platform/v1 Schemas
items.description: JSON schemas for platform descriptor, requests, responses, and artifact staging handoffs.

items.title: contracts/manifest/v1 Schemas
items.description: JSON schemas for transaction-journal and install-manifest with checksum verification.

items.title: contracts/analyzer/v1 Schemas
items.description: JSON schemas for Finding, machine report, limitations, and confidence levels.

items.title: Contract Example Fixtures
items.description: Valid and invalid JSON examples for all schemas covering descriptors, plans, and reports.

items.title: internal/protocol/ Go Types
items.description: Typed Go wire and manifest structures mirroring JSON schemas with validation boundaries.

items.title: Descriptor Trust Validator
items.description: Root ownership, permission masking, and symlink-traversal security verification for descriptors.

items.title: Adapter Client Subprocess Runner
items.description: Deadline-enforced, process-group isolated execution with bounded stdout/stderr capture.

items.title: Platform Client Subprocess Runner
items.description: Bounded platform provider execution over the common JSON subprocess envelope.

items.title: Contract Conformance Suite
items.description: Comprehensive Go tests verifying descriptor rejection, protocol mismatch, and schema validity.

items.title: Architecture Boundary Check
items.description: AST/import test ensuring core never imports sddm, arch, or display-manager-specific symbols.

items.title: SDDM Adapter Descriptor
items.description: Static adapter.json declaring supported DM, version constraints, and required capabilities.

items.title: Arch Platform Descriptor
items.description: Static platform.json declaring Arch distribution support, pacman packaging, and systemd.

items.title: Selection Flow Fixtures

sprints.name: Sprint 0
sprints.subtitle: Feasibility, Baseline & Architecture Correction
sprints.goal: Verify the upstream SDDM integration boundary, dual-helper PAM concurrency, and sensor feasibility.

items.title: SDDM v0.21.0 Baseline Pin
items.description: Pinned upstream commit 63780fcd on Arch package sddm 0.21.0-7 baseline.

items.title: Dual-Helper Concurrency Feasibility
items.description: Prototyped two concurrent PAM transactions under SDDM daemon supervision.

items.title: Message Flow Mapping
items.description: Traced greeter → daemon → helper → PAM communication across stock SDDM.

items.title: Rejection of Theme-Only Auth
items.description: Formally proved QML cannot act as authentication authority or start second PAM transactions.

items.title: Isolated PAM Test Client
items.description: Developed C client testing isolated pam_start_confdir with sddm-fingerprint policy.

items.title: pam_fprintd Cancellation Probe
items.description: Verified sensor release and PAM handle cleanup during active fprintd verification.

items.title: Method-Aware IPC Definition
items.description: Designed typed protocol messages for request ID, auth method, and progress states.

items.title: Hardware Baseline Record
items.description: Documented Synaptics 06cb:00bd USB topology, match-on-sensor constraints, and handoff rules.

sprints.name: Sprint 1
sprints.subtitle: SDDM Concurrent Auth Core & Physical Matrix R01–R16
sprints.goal: Implement method-aware concurrent authentication in SDDM daemon and verify R01–R16 physical matrix.

items.title: Patch 0001: Concurrent Auth Methods
items.description: Upstream-quality SDDM daemon patch adding password and fingerprint PAM helpers.

items.title: Dedicated PAM Service sddm-fingerprint
items.description: Independent PAM service file dedicated exclusively to biometric authentication.

items.title: IPC Request UUID Binding
items.description: Extended daemon/helper IPC binding every auth transaction to an explicit request UUID.

items.title: Dual Helper Lifecycle Supervision
items.description: Daemon coordinates two concurrent helpers per seat without interfering with session creation.

items.title: Atomic Winner-Selection Gate
items.description: First successful method atomically wins; losing transaction is immediately revoked.

items.title: Losing Transaction Cleanup
items.description: Losing PAM transaction calls pam_end and helper terminates within 5s grace period.

items.title: Winner-Only Session Authorization
items.description: Only the verified winner reaches account management, setcred, and open_session.

items.title: Legacy Password & Autologin Preservation
items.description: Stock SDDM behavior remains completely intact when biometric is disabled.

items.title: R01: Concurrent Auth Active
items.description: Two helper PIDs, same request, distinct methods active in PAM simultaneously.

items.title: R02: Password Wins While Reader Waits
items.description: Password login succeeds; fingerprint helper terminates and cleans up before session open.

items.title: R03: Fingerprint Wins With Password Pending
items.description: Biometric match wins; password loser cleaned up; single session authorized.

items.title: R04: Simultaneous Success Arbitration
items.description: Deterministic winner selection when both callbacks occur in tight race conditions.

items.title: R05: Fingerprint Cancellation & Late Success
items.description: Cancelled helper cannot win; observed exit releases winner gate cleanly.

items.title: R06: User Switch Invalidates Request
items.description: Changing user cancels active biometric helper; old print cannot authenticate new user.

items.title: R07: Session Switch Replaces Request
items.description: Selecting another desktop session refreshes request identity and binds helper.

items.title: R08: Invalid Finger, Timeout & Unavailable
items.description: Sensor failures do not crash SDDM or prevent subsequent password login.

items.title: R09: Display Stop During Auth
items.description: Daemon shutdown sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL to helpers; zero zombie processes.

items.title: R10: Fingerprint Failure Then Retry
items.description: Failed biometric attempt allows new generation helper to start successfully.

items.title: R11: Password Failure Then Retry
items.description: Invalid password allows typing retry across helper generation lifecycles.

items.title: R12: Password-Only Without Reader
items.description: Missing fprintd or sensor falls back transparently to standard password login.

items.title: R13: Autologin Preservation
items.description: Stock SDDM autologin executes without spawning biometric helpers.

items.title: R14: Logind Session Reuse
items.description: Existing logind user sessions activate without duplicate session leaks.

items.title: R15: Logout / Relogin Freshness
items.description: Ending Hyprland session returns cleanly to greeter with fresh authentication context.

items.title: R16: Account Policy Denial Recovery
items.description: Denied PAM account check aborts session and allows clean password recovery.

sprints.name: Sprint 2
sprints.subtitle: Greeter API, Theme Lifecycle & Physical Matrix G01–G16
sprints.goal: Expose safe biometric state APIs in GreeterProxy, build fplogin QML theme, and verify actual-surface G01–G16 matrix.

items.title: Wire Protocol & 8 Typed States
items.description: Explicit state protocol: unavailable, ready, scanning, retry, matched, failed, cancelled, timed_out.

items.title: Selection Serial & Context UUID
items.description: Context acknowledgment tuple binds GreeterProxy properties to daemon request identity.

items.title: GreeterProxy Safe Method APIs
items.description: Exposes fingerprint availability, typed states, and explicit start/cancel methods.

items.title: Controlling View & Mirror Promotion
items.description: Single controlling view ownership prevents multi-screen duplicate sensor activations.

items.title: Embedded Theme Fallback Barrier
items.description: Clean fallback to stock password login if custom QML fails to load or corrupts.

items.title: Isolated Qt 6 Build & 10 CTest Suites
items.description: Full compilation in clean container; 9 production suites + 1 theme suite pass 100%.

items.title: 2026-10-20 Bounded Activation Correction
items.description: Asynchronous StartServiceByName activation of inactive fprintd within 5s deadline on context & retry.

items.title: fplogin SDDM Theme Main.qml
items.description: High-contrast, accessible QtQuick/Controls theme without plasma/kde dependencies.

items.title: Automatic Start Without Enter
items.description: Reader activates automatically upon concrete user selection; zero Enter keystrokes needed.

items.title: Immediately Focused Password Field
items.description: Password field acquires immediate focus; typing is never blocked during scanning.

items.title: Password Retention on Retry/Timeout
items.description: Typed password text is preserved across biometric timeouts, retry guidance, and cancellations.

items.title: Keyboard Navigation & Virtual Viewport
items.description: Accessible Tab navigation, Enter submission, Escape cancel, and viewport scrolling above virtual keyboard.

items.title: G01: Cold Greeter Initial User Activation
items.description: Cold activation verified with active fprintd precondition; live inactive-service retry plumbing verified in preflight.

items.title: G02: Password Wins During Scan
items.description: Typing & submitting password during biometric scan cancels fingerprint loser and logs in cleanly.

items.title: G03: Fingerprint Wins With Password Pending
items.description: Verified under controlled diagnostic scheduling; natural race interleaving remains pending.

items.title: G04: Invalid Finger Retry & Password Recovery
items.description: Verified on hardware 2026-10-22: non-enrolled finger touch guidance, PAM_MAXTRIES rc=11 exhaustion, normal exit, 34.8s no-restart window, retained password recovery to Hyprland seat0.

items.title: G05: Fingerprint 30s Deadline & Races
items.description: Verify outer 30s timeout yields timed_out only after exit; success-first across deadline vs timeout-first rejection.
items.evidence: Next in queue; autonomous guest-event timing prepared.

items.title: G06: Missing Reader/Service & Unenrolled User
items.description: Verify unavailable states for absent service, absent USB node, and unenrolled account without auto restart loop.

items.title: G07: User/Session Change & Rapid A–B–A
items.description: Verify context change cancels old helper; late result cannot authenticate new user.

items.title: G08: Cancel Before Ack & Explicit Retry
items.description: Verify cancellation before daemon ack is not dropped; retry successfully reclaims reader.

items.title: G09: Password Failure Then Retry
items.description: Verify wrong password failure leaves fingerprint active and allows typing recovery.

items.title: G10: Account Denial After Biometric Match
items.description: Verify PAM account check failure after sensor match prevents session creation and restores fallback.

items.title: G11: Partial Theme Startup & Fallback
items.description: Verify broken QML triggers clean fallback transition to embedded stock password greeter.

items.title: G12: Multi-Monitor Display Management
items.description: Verify exactly one controlling view activates biometric; mirror screen destruction is harmless.

items.title: G13: Keyboard Navigation & Scaled Surface
items.description: Preliminary smoke passed at scale 2x/2.5x; full accessible navigation matrix pending.

items.title: G14: Greeter Destruction, Power & Suspend
items.description: Verify display manager stop, suspend, and ACPI powerdown cleanly clean up all helpers.
items.evidence: Shutdown helper termination crash observed; orderly cleanup pending.

items.title: G15: Logout / Relogin & Compatibility
items.description: Verify fresh state across multiple login cycles and stock/new proxy compatibility pairings.

items.title: G16: Secret Exposure Comprehensive Audit
items.description: Audit all logs, journal exports, QMP dumps, and core files for prohibited credentials.

sprints.name: Sprint 3
sprints.subtitle: PAM Service & Arch Packaging
sprints.goal: Author reproducible Arch PKGBUILD, dedicate sddm-fingerprint PAM service, and packaging metadata.

items.title: sddm-fingerprint PAM Service Definition
items.description: Package-owned Arch PAM configuration dedicated to pam_fprintd authentication.

items.title: Distribution Account/Session Policy
items.description: Reuses system-login account and session policies without prompting for passwords.

items.title: Retry & Timeout Module Parameters
items.description: Configures pam_fprintd max_tries and timeout options matching SDDM deadline design.

items.title: Arch PKGBUILD Recipe
items.description: Official Arch packaging script building patched SDDM from pinned commit and patch series.

items.title: Package Conflicts / Provides Rules
items.description: Conservative package conflicts=(sddm) and provides=(sddm) definitions.

items.title: Theme & Assets Packaging
items.description: Install targets for /usr/share/sddm/themes/fplogin/ with strict root:root modes.

items.title: SDDM Drop-in Configuration
items.description: Generates /etc/sddm.conf.d/fplogin.conf selecting theme and authentication settings.

items.title: Clean Chroot Build Verification
items.description: Compiles and packages reproducibly inside an isolated devtools arch-chroot.

sprints.name: Sprint 4
sprints.subtitle: Transactional Installer & Rollback Engine
sprints.goal: Build the core Go transaction engine, pre-mutation journaling, and rollback uninstaller.

items.title: Read-Only Preflight & Plan Generator
items.description: Inspects system state and renders declarative change plan without mutating files.

items.title: Dynamic Display Manager Detection
items.description: Queries platform provider for active/installed DM candidates via systemd aliases.

items.title: Adapter Compatibility Negotiation
items.description: Matches detected DM with available adapter descriptors using capability predicates.

items.title: Prerequisite Validation & Installation
items.description: Checks fprintd, libfprint, compatible sensor, and enrolled biometric credentials.

items.title: Explicit Confirmation on DM Migration
items.description: Requires explicit administrator opt-in before disabling LightDM, GDM, or other DMs.

items.title: Atomic File Operations Engine
items.description: Executes closed vocabulary operations (write_file_atomic, create_directory, etc.).

items.title: Pre-Mutation Transaction Journal
items.description: Writes and fsyncs transaction-journal.json before each mutation stage.

items.title: Crash Recovery & Rollback Engine
items.description: Reverts partial operations in reverse order using compensation records upon error or interrupt.

items.title: Final Manifest Publication
items.description: Atomically publishes /var/lib/fplogin/manifest.json only after verification passes.
items.evidence: Implemented in internal/core/manifest/manifest.go and installer.go Phase 11

items.title: Checksum-Aware Uninstaller
items.description: Reads manifest, verifies file checksums, restores prior DM, and leaves no residual configuration.

sprints.name: Sprint 5
sprints.subtitle: System Difference Analyzer
sprints.goal: Build the evidence-based system difference analyzer reporting password-derived facilities.

items.title: PAM Configuration & Include-Tree Probe
items.description: Inspects PAM stacks to detect password-dependent pam_kwallet, pam_gnome_keyring, etc.
items.evidence: Implemented in internal/core/analyze/pam.go (cycle-safe PAM include/substack parser)

items.title: KWallet & GNOME Keyring Probes
items.description: Checks if user wallets are configured to unlock with the login password.
items.evidence: Implemented in internal/core/analyze/wallets.go (KWallet & GNOME Keyring probes)

items.title: Secret Service & Credential Storage Probes
items.description: Identifies applications expecting automatic secret service unlocking on login.
items.evidence: Implemented in internal/core/analyze/wallets.go (Secret service auto-unlock probe)

items.title: systemd-homed & LUKS Crypttab Probes
items.description: Reports home directory encryption or secondary volume mounts requiring login passwords.

items.title: Session Startup Integration Probes
items.description: Checks desktop environment startup hooks (Hyprland exec-once, xdg-autostart).
items.evidence: Implemented in internal/core/analyze/session.go (Hyprland exec-once & autostart probes)

items.title: Confidence Model & Impact Classification
items.description: Assigns confirmed, likely, or unknown confidence with none, info, degraded, or blocked impact.

items.title: Terminal Human Report Renderer
items.description: Renders deterministic terminal text with component, evidence, comparison, and suggestions.

items.title: Machine-Readable JSON Report Renderer
items.description: Emits JSON adhering to contracts/analyzer/v1/report.schema.json for external consumption.

sprints.name: Sprint 6
sprints.subtitle: Security & Resilience Hardening
sprints.goal: Conduct exhaustive threat modeling, race fuzzing, CVE review, and fault injection.

items.title: Greeter IPC Threat Modeling & Fuzzing
items.description: Fuzz SocketServer and GreeterProxy with malformed packets, stale serials, and out-of-order UUIDs.
items.evidence: Blocked until Sprint 2 acceptance and live SDDM harness

items.title: Helper Process Lifecycle Stress Tests
items.description: Test helper crashes (SIGSEGV, SIGKILL) and ensure daemon recovers and cleans up PID states.
items.evidence: Blocked until Sprint 2 acceptance and live SDDM harness

items.title: fprintd Service Fault Injection
items.description: Simulate sudden sensor detachment, D-Bus service crash, and slow response timeouts.
items.evidence: Blocked until Sprint 2 acceptance and live SDDM harness

items.title: Zero Secret Leakage Audit
items.description: Exhaustively scan logs, core dumps, journal exports, and IPC streams for passwords and biometric templates.

items.title: Filesystem Security & Symlink Audit
items.description: Verify mode 0600/0700 enforcement, no symlink traversal vulnerabilities, and safe temp files.

items.title: CVE-Relevant Attention/Intent UI Review
items.description: Audit greeter against visual spoofing and deceptive state indicators.
items.evidence: Blocked until Sprint 2 acceptance and live greeter UI

items.title: Privileged Code Security Review
items.description: Independent security audit of sddm-helper PAM backend, setuid transitions, and installer root execution.
items.evidence: Blocked until Sprint 2 acceptance and live sddm-helper PAM backend

items.title: Resource Exhaustion & DoS Limits
items.description: Validate max helper limits, rate limiting on rapid retries, and bounded memory usage.
items.evidence: Implemented in internal/processrunner (bounded output buffers & execution timeouts)

sprints.name: Sprint 7
sprints.subtitle: End-to-End Validation, Release & Upstreaming
sprints.goal: Complete end-to-end certification on Arch + Hyprland, prepare upstream SDDM PR, and publish v1 release.

items.title: Complete Cold-Boot Lifecycle Matrix
items.description: Full automated test matrix covering boot, sleep/wake, display plug/unplug, and reboot.

items.title: Hyprlock Handoff Verification
items.description: Verify sensor release by SDDM helper allows smooth hyprlock lockscreen fingerprint acquisition.

items.title: Clean Install -> Login -> Uninstall Cycle
items.description: Full end-to-end lifecycle on pristine Arch test installation without operator intervention.

items.title: Emergency Recovery Documentation
items.description: Verified documentation for TTY recovery, manual package downgrade, and safe rollback.

items.title: Upstream SDDM Pull Request
items.description: Split, reviewable, upstream-quality Git commit series submitted to github.com/sddm/sddm.

items.title: Upstream Tracking & Conflict Strategy
items.description: Documented procedure for rebasing patches against new upstream SDDM releases.

items.title: Signed Release Artifacts & Checksums
items.description: Cryptographically signed tarballs, pacman packages, and verification manifests.

items.title: Final Independent Acceptance Review
items.description: Formal Sol gate sign-off verifying all DoD requirements before v1.0 tag.
